parts.header:
step G33 of the content expansion, the multi-hit moves Dual Wingbeat, Twin Beam and Triple Axel and the ability Mirror Armor: the marks and the handler numbers (the hit counts are in the handler ids; the static hit columns have no reader in the engine, duoforge.data.static_unread checks that), and Triple Axel's accuracy 90. The recorded battles g33_* are replayed by duoforge.reference.conformance_pool_data.

Split by subject from the test of step G33 (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old name).

step G33 of the content expansion, the later hits of a multiaccuracy move: they are checked with the loop's own arithmetic (scripts.ts:481-510), proved for the accuracy 90 only (every multiaccuracy move of the pool has it, another accuracy is refused), and the engine plays it only without a ModifyAccuracy handler on the user: a Triple Axel user with Wide Lens is refused at its second hit, E_UNSUPPORTED, never played with the first hit's arithmetic.

Split by subject from the test of step G33 (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old name).
